narrative_vs_numbers.management_says: Targeting 20% plus growth and stable returns.
narrative_vs_numbers.numbers_say: Revenues and profits show volatility across quarters.

promises.credibility: Management provides detailed forward-looking metrics, but several horizons remain pending or subject to shifting macroeconomic conditions.

bull: Latest quarter Sep 2026 shows strong growth with revenue up 26 percent YoY, NII up 31 percent, and PAT up 298 percent.
Revenue shows steady compounding with a CAGR of around 20 percent over both 3-year and 5-year periods.
Guidance for the full year expects credit cost to remain within 4 percent based on October 2026 data.
bear: Returns are currently moderate with an ROCE of 9.98 percent and an ROE of 10.5 percent.
Profit lags revenue significantly over 3 years, showing a PAT CAGR of negative 2 percent compared to 20 percent revenue growth.
Borrowing costs are guided to stay in the 9.2 percent to 9.3 percent range until March according to October 2026 data.
